personality_one_liner: A cinematic, premium CRM experience that feels like a luxury aesthetic brand rather than a clinical software tool.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Allow the UI to breathe. Do not cramp content. Use glassmorphism to separate overlapping elements instead of borders where possible.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use on the bottom tab bar
Use on 'Featured' or 'Priority' cards like the 'DA FISSARE ADESSO' section
dont's: Do not apply to form fields or body text regions
Do not overdo it. Keep to 1-2 glass surfaces per screen max

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard highlighting operational priorities like 'DA FISSARE ADESSO'.
screens.layout: Hero section showing total leads and quick status. Below, a critical glassmorphic card for 'DA FISSARE ADESSO' containing urgent leads that require appointment scheduling.

screens.name: Chat
screens.purpose: WhatsApp-like messaging interface optimized for one-handed use, with an AI vs Operator toggle.

states.empty: Illustration of a quiet inbox with a prompt.

screens.layout: List view of active chats. Inside a chat: large, easy-to-reach multimodal input bar at the bottom. A sticky floating glass toggle at the top or bottom for AI/Operator mode. A prominent 'PRENDI CONVERSAZIONE' or 'RIATTIVA AI' primary CTA dynamically visible when needed.

screens.name: Clienti
screens.purpose: Searchable list of clients with a detailed view containing the AI-generated summary.
screens.layout: Search bar at top. Client list below. On tap: opens a detail sheet/screen featuring a tinted icon container for initials (or photo), lead temperature badge, and a beautifully formatted AI Summary text block.

screens.name: Pipeline
screens.purpose: Visual board tracking leads across 8 stages, emphasizing the 'DA FISSARE APPUNTAMENTO' column.
screens.layout: Vertical-stack or collapsible-section Kanban layout (better for mobile). The 'DA FISSARE' stage should stand out visually (e.g., using a brand-tinted glass background or stronger border). Include a persistent 'Cambia Stato' button on lead cards.

screens.name: Analytics
screens.purpose: Dashboard for performance metrics, conversion rates, and campaign tracking.
screens.layout: Grid of KPI cards (2-col where appropriate), clear typography for numbers, and a pinned filter row for periods/campaigns.

screens.name: Altro
screens.purpose: Menu for Settings, Services, Clinics (Sedi), Campaigns, Team, AI Knowledge Base, and Integrations.
screens.layout: Clean, list-based navigation menu with Feather icons for each row.

chat_empty_state.alt: Clean champagne textured background for empty chat state

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use any emojis for the lead temperatures (Molto Calda, Interessata, etc.) in the UI. Map them to semantic background/text colors in the JSON: Molto Calda -> error (Ruby), Interessata -> warning (Amber), Da Coltivare -> success (Sage), Non Qualificata -> info (Grey). Render them as elegant text badges or pills.
The UI is completely Italian, so ensure all hardcoded text (empty states, buttons) remains in Italian.

Implement a Dark-first Luxe aesthetic. Use deep blacks (surface/surfaceSecondary) rather than pure black everywhere. Text should be off-white (Ivory) with Champagne Gold as the primary action and highlight color.

Pipeline Screen: Since it's mobile, avoid a pure horizontal scrolling Kanban if it becomes too dense. Implement a vertical list of collapsible stages, or at least highly optimized cards. Make the 'DA FISSARE APPUNTAMENTO' stage visually distinct using the `brandTertiary` background.

Chat Screen: Must be one-handed friendly. Keep the primary AI toggle or 'PRENDI CONVERSAZIONE' button pinned at the bottom area just above the input, or in a highly accessible floating glass container.
Apply gradient-to-dark scrims (Layer 0 image, Layer 1 linear gradient, Layer 2 text) when rendering text over any background image, such as the Home hero.
